items.title: Constructible sheaves are compact with respect to filtered colimits
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that constructible sheaves of sets, abelian groups or Lambda-modules are compact with respect to filtered colimits (statement lines 12496-12508). The proof (proof lines 12510-12525) reduces to the representable or n-torsion generators supplied by the structure lemmas and uses the commutation of sections with filtered colimits, with the additional identification of the Hom group out of j_{U!}Z/nZ as n-torsion. H2: one reduction applied to three cases, written out.
